nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 用現在簡單式表達習慣、反覆事件與一般事實。

naturalExamples.text: I walk to school every day.
My brother plays soccer on Fridays.

wrong.text: He walk to school every day.

better.text: He walks to school every day.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 第三人稱單數 he 的現在簡單式動詞通常加 -s。

wrong.text: She is plays tennis on Fridays.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 現在簡單式的一般動詞不和 is 這樣連用。

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 第三人稱單數 sister 要用 reads。

wrong.text: The sun rise in the east.

better.text: The sun rises in the east.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 一般事實使用現在簡單式，單數主詞加 -s。

nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 把 always、usually、often、sometimes、never 放在自然的位置。

wrong.text: I play usually soccer after school.

better.text: I usually play soccer after school.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 頻率副詞通常放在一般動詞前。
頻率副詞通常放在 be 後；前者只在特殊強調時可能出現。

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: often 放在主要動詞 take 前。
be 句的 never 通常放在 is 後。

nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 依習慣、事實、此刻或暫時情況選擇現在簡單或進行式。
nodes.form: routine/fact: present simple; now/temporary: present continuous

naturalExamples.text: I brush my teeth every morning.
I am brushing my teeth now.
Amy is taking the bus today.

wrong.text: Look! The dog runs after the ball.

better.text: Look! The dog is running after the ball.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 眼前正在發生的動作通常用現在進行式。

wrong.text: I am going to school by bus every day.

better.text: I go to school by bus every day.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 固定習慣通常用現在簡單式；進行式會暗示暫時安排。

wrong.text: I am usually getting up at seven.

better.text: I usually get up at seven.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 穩定習慣使用現在簡單式。

better.text: Be quiet! The baby is sleeping.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 此刻正在發生，用現在進行式。

nodes.titleEn: There Is/Are, Countability, and Basic Quantity
nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 描述存在，並搭配單複數、some 與 any。
nodes.form: there is + singular/uncountable; there are + plural

naturalExamples.text: There is a book on the desk.
There are three books on the desk.
There is some water in the bottle.

wrong.text: There have a park near my house.

better.text: There is a park near my house.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 英文存在句使用 there is，不直翻中文的「有」成 have。
複數 apples 搭配 are。

wrong.text: There are some milk in the fridge.

better.text: There is some milk in the fridge.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: milk 是不可數名詞，搭配 is。
一般否定句常使用 any。

acceptableVariants.noteZh: 口語常聽到 there's + 複數；正式學習與寫作使用 there are。
